item.title: Lana Del Rey's latest track 'White Feather Hawk Tail Deer Hunter' is positively strange
item.description: Lana Del Rey fans know not to take her fully at her word: Her long-awaited country album has been in the works for years now, yet it still lacks a clear release date. Originally announced in January 2024, the album has since undergone several delays and name changes. item.title: Food for Thought with Yeung '29: Al Forno - the best Italian in Providence?
item.description: When you ask someone about their favorite restaurant in Providence, one name comes up a lot - Al Forno. Love it or hate it, it's a Rhode Island institution - a husband-and-wife affair that began as a side project by two RISD-trained artists. Some say it made Providence a culinary hotspot when it opened in 1980. Forty six years later, a table at Al Forno is still a hot commodity.All my meals at Al Forno start the same. item.description: This fall, I heard Hannah Pingree '98 speak at the University Club in Providence during a fundraising stop on her Maine gubernatorial campaign. item.title: Chigozie Obioma, author of 'The Road to the Country,' talks writing on war in lecture

item.title: Paxson details University response to Dec. 13 in first sit-down interview since shooting
item.description: On Dec. 13, the Brown community lost two students in an act of mass violence on campus.Just five minutes before the shooting took place, President Christina Paxson P'19 P'MD'20 took off on a plane to Washington D.C. item.title: Editorial: What happened at Columbia reminds us the University has little recourse against ICE
item.description: At roughly 6:30 a.m. Thursday, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested Columbia senior Elmina Aghayeva in her university-owned apartment. The agents entered the building under false pretenses - allegedly impersonating police officers and claiming to be searching for a missing child.
